${modID}:BrambleStrike.NAME: Bramble Strike
${modID}:BrambleStrike.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL Deal damage equal to your Thorns (!${modID}:thorns!).

${modID}:Exfoliate.NAME: Exfoliate
${modID}:Exfoliate.DESCRIPTION: Remove 3X Block. For every Block removed, gain 1 Strength.

${modID}:Backpedal.NAME: Backpedal
${modID}:Backpedal.DESCRIPTION: Gain !B! Block. NL Draw !M! cards. NL Place 1 card from your hand on top of your draw pile.

${modID}:Patch.NAME: Patch
${modID}:Patch.DESCRIPTION: Gain Block equal to your missing health (!B!).

${modID}:Rally.NAME: Rally
${modID}:Rally.DESCRIPTION: If you block all incoming attacks with no unblocked damage, gain !M! strength.

${modID}:ShedBark.NAME: Shed Bark
${modID}:ShedBark.DESCRIPTION: Remove !B! Block. NL Deal damage equal to !M! times the block removed to ALL enemies.

${modID}:Corner.NAME: Corner
${modID}:Corner.DESCRIPTION: Search your draw pile for a card, and then place it on top. NL Gain !B! Block. ${modID}:Parry.

${modID}:BeFirst.NAME: Be First
${modID}:BeFirst.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. If this was the first card played, enter ${modID}:Counter.

${modID}:StrengthAndConditioning.NAME: Strength and Conditioning
${modID}:StrengthAndConditioning.DESCRIPTION: Whenever you are dealt unblocked damage, gain !M! Strength and Dexterity the following turn.

${modID}:BarkChin.NAME: Bark Chin
${modID}:BarkChin.DESCRIPTION: When you take unblocked damage, reduce it by !M!.

${modID}:Knockout.NAME: Knock Out
${modID}:Knockout.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL ${modID}:Counter: Stun. NL Exhaust.

${modID}:OneTwo.NAME: One-Two
${modID}:OneTwo.DESCRIPTION: Deal !D! damage. NL ${modID}:Counter: Deal !D! damage again.

${modID}:SizeUp.NAME: Size Up
${modID}:SizeUp.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! cards. NL Gain Block equal to cards in hand (!B!). NL ${modID}:Parry: Draw !M! cards.
